mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as companies adjust to increased productivity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face reduced output and potential earnings shortfalls.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings increase.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as related sectors adjust to reduced activity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST declines by more than 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 25bps.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face reduced demand and increased costs.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 declines and CPIAUCSL increases.
